description: Describes the BANK-AWS-001 static evidence bundle under evidence/aws/. Validated by infra/aws-cdk/lib/evidence-validator.ts (npm run validate:evidence). Static evidence only: not a deployment record or certification.

files.description: Evidence overview, toolchain, layout, known gaps.
sha256sum(1) lines over tracked files in owned paths, relative to repo root; excludes itself.
Credential-free wrapper for CDK/npm commands (logs output and exit code).
Wrapper for git/gh/rclone commands at repo root (logs output and exit code, scrubs token-like strings).
One row per command: <log file>\t<exit code>\t<command>.
Pre/post rebase SHA mapping onto origin/main.
JSON conversion of the nag CSV.

rules.sha256sums-verify: Every listed file exists and its sha256 matches.
rules.commands-tsv: Each row has 3 tab-separated fields; exit code is an integer; the log file exists under logs/ and its '# exit_code:' trailer equals the TSV exit code.
rules.template-env-agnostic: Template contains no literal 12-digit AWS account IDs.
rules.manifest-env-agnostic: Every stack artifact environment is aws://unknown-account/unknown-region.
rules.nag-zero-noncompliant: At least one rule row and zero Non-Compliant rows.
rules.jest-all-passed: success is true and numFailedTests is 0.
